MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)

MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
WITH p, t, c,
     CASE

       ELSE strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
     END AS birth_date

             THEN 1 ELSE 0

MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
WITH p, t, c,
     CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/'
          THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
          ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2) AS INT64)
     END AS birth_year,
     CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/'
          THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
          ELSE CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
                 WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
                 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
                 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
                 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12

     END AS birth_day

       2026 - birth_year - CASE
